documents.unit: School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence (AI MS program)
documents.title: AI MS Handbook 2026-2027
documents.quality_note: Handbook of about 74k chars; the AI rule is one passage in the academic integrity section: 'Unless explicitly allowed by your instructor, using generative AI tools to complete any portion of a course assignment or exam will be considered academic dishonesty and a violation of the ASU Academic Integrity Policy. Students confirmed to engage in non-allowable use of generative AI will be sanctioned according to the academic integrity policy and FSE sanctioning guidelines.' It restates the university default for one graduate program.
